desc:
EARLY ACCESS: the game is still being built. Expect bugs, changes and new content along the way, and tell us what you find!

Real offroad driving. Tires squash over rocks, mud and sand give way under you, and picking the right line matters. Air down, lock your diffs, drop into low range, and winch or strap your way out when you get stuck.

DRIVE 11 vehicles free: rock crawlers, prerunners, a 6x6, pickups, 4x4s and more. Game passes unlock the Class 2 Crawler, the Recovery Wrecker and the Recovery Chopper.

PLAY
- Free roam: Test Area (a server of your own), Canyon, Dunes and the RC Car Track
- Career: recovery jobs from Con's Garage
- Tutorial: learn the ropes with Con
- Sumo: push other trucks off a sky island
- RC trucks and RC races

BUILD your truck in the garage: paint, liveries, wheels, tires, lights, bumpers and exhausts. Your setups save.

Convoy up with friends. More maps are on the way.

Best played with a controller.
